mouse_psm_somites_specimen.species: Vertebrate paraxial mesoderm / somite embryo dorsal SEM (transferred as structural reference for mouse presomitic mesoderm and segmented somite periodicity)

hubaud_2017_governing_equations.section: Hubaud, Regev, Mahadevan & Pourquie (2017) Cell 171:668-682 Figs. 1-7 & STAR Methods
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.fast_activator_pde: tau_u * du/dt = u - u^3 / 3 - v + I_eff(Y_nuc, J_Dll1) + D_u * nabla^2 u
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.slow_inhibitor_ode: tau_v * dv/dt = u + a - b * v,  epsilon = tau_u / tau_v
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.yap_gated_excitability_current: I_eff = I_basal + J_Dll1 - gamma_YAP * Y_nuc(A_cell, E_sub)
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.cubic_nullcline_extrema_law: f(u) = u - u^3 / 3  =>  f'(u) = 1 - u^2 = 0 at u = +/- 1, with knee heights f(+1) = +2/3, f(-1) = -2/3, barrier Delta_f = 4/3
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.jacobian_trace_and_determinant: Tr(tau_u * J(u^*)) = 1 - (u^*)^2 - epsilon * b,  det(tau_u * J(u^*)) = epsilon * (1 - b * (1 - (u^*)^2)) > 0
hubaud_2017_governing_equations.hopf_bifurcation_threshold_law: |u_H| = sqrt(1 - epsilon * b),  I_H_lower = -a/b + u_H^3/3 - u_H * (1 - 1/b)

canonical_fhn_parameters.species: Mus musculus (E9.5-E10.5 mouse presomitic mesoderm LuVeLu Lfng-Venus / Hes7 reporter)

hubaud_2017_experimental_regimes.source: Hubaud, Regev, Mahadevan & Pourquie (2017) Cell 171:668-682 Figs. 1-6 (primary mouse LuVeLu PSM cell assays)

regimes.label: Isolated PSM cell spread on fibronectin (high nuclear YAP, excitable quiescent)
Isolated PSM cell on Dll1-coated fibronectin (Notch signal present but high YAP blocks oscillation)
Isolated PSM cell + Latrunculin A (F-actin depolymerization lowers nuclear YAP -> autonomous oscillations)
Isolated PSM cell + Rockout / Y-27632 ROCK inhibition (lowers cytoskeletal tension & nuclear YAP)
Intact high-density mPSM explant + Dll1-Notch coupling (low nuclear YAP + traveling waves)
Constitutively active nuclear Yap5SA overexpression + Latrunculin A (quiescent arrest)
